Each quest's page: its words, counts, rewards, money, experience and reputation from foreverchanges.pro (Wowhead's Forever database). The new NPCs' type, family and rank and the rewards' stats: Wowhead's tooltips; the rewards' slots, binding and prices: the Forever client's Item and ItemSparse (wago.tools, build 1.60.1.70532). Quest text (c) Blizzard Entertainment.

page.objectives_text: Collect 6 Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.
page.description: <The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>$B$B<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>

page.objectives_text: Bring 15 Glittering Sunstones to Mor'rogal.
page.description: In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.$B$BWhile you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.

page.objectives_text: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
page.description: The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.$B$BThe trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
page.progress: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
page.completion: You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.$B$BI'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.

page.objectives_text: Bring 6 Jagged Orc Swords and 4 Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
page.description: Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.$B$BWe need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.$B$BFight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.

page.objectives_text: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
page.description: Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.$B$BAnyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.$B$BI've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
page.progress: How goes the huntin'?
page.completion: Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!$B$BOh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?

page.objectives_text: Bring 10 Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
page.description: Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!$B$BI can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
page.progress: Gotta keep the forges going!
page.completion: Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!

page.objectives_text: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
page.description: Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.$B$BI'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
page.progress: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
page.completion: Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.$B$BHere, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.

page.objectives_text: Search for Corma's partner Essene.
page.description: Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!$B$BI managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!$B$BPlease, if you see any sign of her, let me know!

page.objectives_text: Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.
need_goals: Escort the fire elemental out of Dun Modr
page.description: Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!$B$BFire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!$B$BNo Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!$B$BLet me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!

page.objectives_text: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
page.description: I have received word back from Darnassus, $N!$B$BFrom the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!$B$BIt is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!$B$BThe naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
page.progress: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!
page.completion: This has been a long journey, Orangequake, but it was worth it.$B$BAt long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace.$B$BThank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.

page.objectives_text: Bring Essene's note back to Corma Villard.
page.description: I just need to finish repacking, and I can get out of here!$B$BIf you'll do me one last favor, here--take this note to Corma. It'll let her know that I'm alive and I'm on my way!

page.objectives_text: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
page.description: Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy. The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
page.completion: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...

page.objectives_text: Kill 6 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
page.description: Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments. This is most frustrating, $N. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
page.completion: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, Chonk.

page.objectives_text: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
page.description: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
page.progress: Yes?
page.completion: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, $C. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.

page.objectives_text: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
page.description: <One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.$B$BBrother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
page.progress: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
page.completion: Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!$B$BThanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?

page.objectives_text: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
page.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
page.progress: Have you rescued my books yet, Braiknok?!
page.completion: Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.$B$BBut there's still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?

page.objectives_text: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
page.description: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
page.completion: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.

page.objectives_text: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
page.description: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
page.progress: Yes?
page.completion: So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, Ingmmar!$B$BLet me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.

page.objectives_text: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
page.description: Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.$B$BGo get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
page.progress: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
page.completion: Thank you for returning these stolen books, Jødekong. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.$B$BYou're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!

page.objectives_text: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
page.description: You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.$B$BGo talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
page.completion: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.

page.objectives_text: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
page.description: I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.$B$BAlong the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.$B$BIf my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
page.progress: Oh. You're back?
page.completion: The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.$B$BHowever, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...$B$B<Renferrel takes the eyes.>$B$BI can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.

page.objectives_text: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
page.description: Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.$B$BNow, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
page.progress: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
page.completion: <Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>$B$BYes, I can feel it working.  I will soon be able to travel.$B$BYou have done me a great favor, Saixgone.

page.objectives_text: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
page.description: We need to take stock of how many books are missing!$B$BGo talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.$B$BHe's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.$B$BDon't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
page.completion: Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.$B$BIt looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.$B$BWhile you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.

page.objectives_text: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
page.description: I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.$B$BWe know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!$B$BArchmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.

page.objectives_text: Speak to Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
page.description: The council will not be happy to learn of our subterfuge, but they cannot deny results. The city is calming down, and we are free to lower our wards.$B$BI think it's only fair you deliver the good word. Take this mote to Archmage Celindra within the Violet Citadel.

page.objectives_text: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
page.description: Calling all anglers!$B$BA giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!$B$B-- Gazlowe
page.progress: What can I do for ya, $R?
page.completion: Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!"all the time?$B$BI might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.

page.objectives_text: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.
page.description: The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine. Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
page.progress: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
page.completion: I see... these gills appear to be healthy, for now. But we must not be complacent.

page.objectives_text: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.
page.description: Oh no... I'm in for it now!$B$BI heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!$B$BIf I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
page.progress: It's a mess out there, Theto! Did you collect the parts I need?
page.completion: Thanks a bunch! I'll get to work on an escape plan. In the meantime, take this!

page.objectives_text: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.
page.description: Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.$B$BDo you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.

page.objectives_text: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.
page.description: It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.$B$BOne thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.

page.objectives_text: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
page.description: I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.$B$BI believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
page.description: The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.$B$BI worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.$B$BIf you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.

page.objectives_text: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
page.description: We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.$B$BCollect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
page.progress: You look chilly, $C. How goes the hunt?
page.completion: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, $C!

page.objectives_text: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten at Gol'Bolar Quarry.
page.description: The keg is stamped:$B$BBLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER$B$BYou get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
page.progress: What's that you've got?
page.completion: <The $R turns pale as he sees the empty keg.>$B$B...Where did you find this?

page.objectives_text: Recover 16 Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.
page.description: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
page.progress: I hope you've got good news for me?
page.completion: That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, $C.$B$BPlease accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.

page.objectives_text: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
page.description: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
page.progress: Do you have something for me, $C?
page.completion: What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.$B$BI welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, $C. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.

page.objectives_text: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
page.description: I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.$B$BThe big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
page.progress: How goes the hunt?
page.completion: Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade.$B$BI've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
page.description: These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.$B$BOh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
page.progress: Greetings, $C. What brings you up to my property today?
page.completion: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.

page.objectives_text: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
page.description: Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.$B$BThere's more to the story but... wait... what's that?$B$BThere's a group of men coming up the ridge!
page.completion: Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.$B$BPlease, take this. It's not much, but its the least I can do.$B$BSafe travels, $C.

page.objectives_text: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
page.description: This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras.$B$BIf you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
page.progress: The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.$B$BI don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
page.completion: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.

page.objectives_text: Slay quilboars and collect 4 of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
page.description: The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.$B$BYou did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.$B$BSlay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!$B$BI will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
page.progress: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
page.completion: I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge!$B$BYou have done me... done us... a great favor, Johnathon.

page.objectives_text: Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards and 8 Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
page.description: Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.$B$BSearch the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
page.completion: Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.$B$BFor now, however, the why is irrelevant.

page.objectives_text: Defeat 10 Young Black Ravagers and 7 Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
page.description: A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.$B$BWith Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.

page.objectives_text: Defeat 8 Splint Fist Warriors and 4 Splint Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
page.description: A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.$B$BWith Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.

page.objectives_text: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.
page.description: <The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.$B$BYou can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
page.progress: Oh what's this, then?
page.completion: Juding by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.$B$BThank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.

page.objectives_text: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
page.description: Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking  the Gol'Bolar Quarry.$B$BIt's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
page.completion: Greetings, friend. How are ya?

page.objectives_text: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
page.description: We be seein' fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I be hearin' there be spiders makin' their nest along the road.$B$BIf your travels be takin' you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
page.completion: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, Joruus. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.

page.objectives_text: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
page.description: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
page.progress: Something need doing?
page.completion: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!

page.objectives_text: Deliver Halikor's Hoof to Orgrimmar.
page.description: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.
page.progress: Yes?
page.completion: What a trophy, $C! That must have been some fight!

page.objectives_text: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
page.description: Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.$B$BOne of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
page.completion: Stay low and try not to be seen, $C. These cultists are not to be trifled with.

page.objectives_text: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
page.description: Danitha and I fought against the scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.$B$BHe might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.$B$BIf only the rest of the forsaken felt the same way...
page.completion: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could use always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.

page.objectives_text: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
page.description: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
page.completion: Thank you for your aid, $C. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.

page.objectives_text: Gather 12 Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
page.description: It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.$B$BDuring the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the scourge of them.
page.progress: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
page.completion: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.

page.objectives_text: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
page.description: You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.$B$BIf you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
page.completion: This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was here from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.$B$BWhen we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.$B$BShe even named the keep after... a mutual friend.

page.objectives_text: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.
page.description: You there, $C. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.$B$BMost don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.$B$BSeek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.$B$BBlood and thunder, $C.
page.progress: It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.$B$BIf these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the qullboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
page.completion: Impressive, $C. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.$B$BLok-tar!

page.objectives_text: Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.
page.description: There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.$B$BFew believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.$B$BGather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
page.progress: It took six of us to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to kill all but myself and one other before we were able to bring it down.$B$BThis far from alliance lands I should leave it well enough alone. Light knows I'll lose little sleep over a few tauren savages or orcish brutes. However, the honor of my fallen brothers demands action.
page.completion: My dead men will rest easier knowing that there is one less of these monsters in the world. You've done well, and are a true and stalwart defender of the alliance. Thank you.$B$BGo with honor, Gryma.

page.objectives_text: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
page.description: All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.$B$BOne raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
page.progress: The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.$B$BUnfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.$B$BStill I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
page.completion: Thank you, $N. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.

page.objectives_text: Deliver the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
page.description: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
page.completion: My, my. How I do love surprises, $N.$B$BThis specimen will surely help further my studies.

page.objectives_text: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
page.description: My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!$B$BPlease, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.$B$BDuties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
page.completion: Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.$B$BSometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.

page.objectives_text: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold
page.description: Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea.$B$BThey made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily.$B$BTake this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
page.progress: I think we can win this one...
page.completion: Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?$B$BOh!$B$BWow... this smells really good! Yummy.$B$BThanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs.$B$BIf it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!

page.objectives_text: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
page.description: Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.$B$BRumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.$B$BKill first, investigate later!
page.completion: So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.$B$BHowever, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.$B$BIn any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!

page.objectives_text: Give Yelmak's Potion to Whuut.
page.description: Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.$B$BHe is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.$B$BGive him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
page.progress: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
page.completion: Grorru--whaa?$B$BYou say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.$B$BMaybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.$B$BDrakath, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
page.description: <Before you is a strange orb and with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.$B$BIt is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
page.completion: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...

page.objectives_text: Bring 5 Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
page.description: "Rezlack, when an opportunity come's knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.$B$BThis orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!$B$BThere are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.$B$BGo harvest some and bring them back to me!
page.progress: It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.$B$BWell, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.$B$BTrust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
page.completion: Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it.$B$BHere's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works.$B$BEither way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.

page.objectives_text: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
page.description: You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.$B$BAs much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?$B$BTake the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.

page.objectives_text: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
page.description: You... abomination...$B$BWhy should... help you...$B$BBe gone...
page.completion: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.

page.objectives_text: Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
page.description: One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?$B$BWell, it doesn't.$B$BOurs is a cursed life, $N. We must take from the living to further our own existence.$B$BWhen we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!$B$BBring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
page.progress: Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.$B$BIt may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.$B$BSimilarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
page.completion: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
page.description: You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!$B$BIt has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.$B$BJust another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.$B$BBut we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!$B$B<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
page.completion: Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!$B$BHere, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?$B$BIf not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.

page.objectives_text: Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore.$B$BBorgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there.
need_goals: Take the boat to Auberdine and find Gorbold Steelhand.
page.description: Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!$B$BA few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.$B$BI haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?$B$BThere's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!
page.completion: Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.$B$BWe could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.

page.objectives_text: Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.$B$BThundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.
page.description: Auberdine is a humble place, $C. You will not hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.$B$BYet Auberdine remains in their shadow.$B$BI would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.$B$BMake our home known.
page.progress: I can smell the sea on you, friend!$B$B<Baros laughs.>$B$BWhat brings you to Stormwind?
page.completion: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>

page.objectives_text: Bring Alexston's Reply to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.
page.description: I wish it was that easy to help, $C. I really do.$B$BShould you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.$B$BGive this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
page.progress: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
page.completion: Sad news indeed. Still, I thank you for making the journey.$B$BWith neither Stormwind nor Darnassus coming to aid us, it seems that Auberdine's fate is our own to decide.

page.objectives_text: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.
page.description: Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.$B$BI have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!$B$BI hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!$B$BOh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.

page.objectives_text: Eliminate 12 Stormscale Myrmidons, 8 Stormscale Sorceresses, and 6 Stormscale Warriors for Arbal at the Grove of the Ancients.
page.description: Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.$B$BScores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.$B$BWhat they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.$B$BWar is what they seek, $C. War... is what we will bring.
page.completion: Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...$B$BIt is unforgivable.

page.objectives_text: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
page.description: Attention!$B$BA reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also know as "Swordfeather".$B$BUnfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.$B$BJai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.$B$BReward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.$B$BThe Auberdine Village Council
page.progress: Greetings $C - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
page.completion: It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness.$B$BRegardless, thank you for your service today, $C. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
page.description: All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.$B$BWhatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.$B$BOnly Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
page.progress: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, $R... what have you brought me?
page.completion: <Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>$B$BStairs descending down in Mathystra? Could be it be?$B$B<Onu shakes his head.>$B$BI must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.$B$BPlease accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.

98042.name: It's All Fun and Games Until...

page.objectives_text: Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.
page.description: <As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>$B$BThey have failed.$B$BYou will be forgotten.$B$BThey will lose the eye they gained.
page.progress: You look troubled. I am listening.
page.completion: <Thundris does not speak for some time.>$B$BThis bears the mark of an ancient evil, $C. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.$B$BAnde'thoras-ethil.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
page.description: <Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>$B$BYou're still here?$B$BTake the phial and get out of my sight, $C. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before.$B$BPerhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.$B$B<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>$B$BI must look elsewhere if this is to work...
page.progress: How may I aid you?
page.completion: Do not mind the Arch Druid, Sneaky. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence.$B$BWait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?

page.objectives_text: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.
need_goals: Sealed Company Request delivered to Hillsbrad council
page.description: Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.$B$BWe're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.$B$BWalk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.$B$BReturn to me when the deed is done.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
page.description: You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.$B$BDo not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.$B$BShe will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
page.progress: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
page.completion: Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.$B$B<Tyrande's face settles.>$B$BI apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.$B$BFandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.$B$BEvery drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.

page.objectives_text: Slay 5 Screeching Harpies, 5 Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and 5 Screeching Windcaller Harpies.
page.description: The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.$B$BI fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.$B$BGo, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.

page.objectives_text: Collect 10 Pristine Crimson Scales and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
page.description: You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.$B$BThe crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.$B$BCrocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!$B$BYou'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!

page.objectives_text: High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok
page.description: Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.$B$BBring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.$B$BOur plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.

page.objectives_text: Deathstalker Masoj needs you to place the three Apothecary Vials on peaks around Hillsbrad Foothills and return to him.
page.description: Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.$B$BTake these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plataeu overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.$B$BLook for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.

page.objectives_text: Bring 5 Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.
page.description: The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!$B$BI would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.$B$BI don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
page.description: My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!$B$BThe Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!$B$BI believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?

page.objectives_text: Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.$B$BYou recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.
page.description: Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?$B$BThe boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.$B$BI apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!

page.objectives_text: Use the Goaz Stone near the Goaz Warder and bring its Titanic Keystone back to Prospector Whelgar.
page.description: Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!$B$BI've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!$B$BTake it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!$B$BIf I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!

page.objectives_text: Speak to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
page.description: Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, $N.$B$BI could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.$B$BHis father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.$B$BThere is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.

page.objectives_text: Find Howin Kindfeather east of Menethil Harbor, along the road.
page.description: After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.$B$BIt was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.$B$BIt didn't last long, sadly.$B$BHowin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Crimson Crate to Howin Kindfeather off the road to the east of Menethil Harbor.
page.description: Word is officially out on those whelps, $N. We already have an order in!$B$BI'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!$B$BThese will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.

page.objectives_text: Collect 10 Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather.
page.description: I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.$B$B<Howin spits.>$B$BI aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.$B$BThese whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.$B$BThe Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.$B$BBring me a handful of the incisors.

page.objectives_text: Kill 6 Shadowhorn Stag and 6 Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.
page.description: Gaaah!$B$BI'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?$B$BOne moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?$B$BWhen I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.$B$BCould you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.

page.objectives_text: Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.
need_goals: Eye of Kilrogg guided to the road
page.description: Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.$B$BI'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.$B$BI can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.

page.objectives_text: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
page.description: Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!$B$BI need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!$B$BCan you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!

page.objectives_text: Bring Carnage's Head to Rethiel the Greenwarden in The Green Belt.
page.description: The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.$B$BI fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.$B$BIt will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.$B$BCarnage will come. Bring me its head.

page.objectives_text: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Reclaimers, 5 Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and 3 Dragonmaw Infiltrators in Dragonmaw Retreat for Howin Kindfeather.
page.description: I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, $N. Or at least learn a thing or two.$B$BDon't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.$B$BRegardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.$B$BI need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.

page.objectives_text: Kill the Subdued Dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates for Howin Kindfeather.
page.description: I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!$B$BThe very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.$B$BAbsolutely not. Not again.$B$BYou have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.$B$BNone of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.

page.objectives_text: Bring 6 Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
page.description: Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.$B$BThese shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.$B$BGo to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
page.progress: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
page.completion: It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.$B$BThese pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.$B$BRegrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.

page.objectives_text: Slay 5 Sickly Refugees and 5 Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
page.description: If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.$B$BWhile I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.$B$BGo to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, $R.
page.completion: It seems the Gilneans are not too keen on allowing anyone past their wall. That is fortunate, I suppose. It means there is likely no chance for the worgen curse to spread to their city.$B$BCan you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?

page.objectives_text: Deliver Howin's Missive to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
page.description: My work here is far from over, $N. And I need tae send word to me wife Claira in Aerie Peak--and get Falstad an update as well.$B$BBut that's my business. Wildhammer business.$B$BThat said, you ought tae let King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge know about all this as well. Wetlands is but a stone's throw from his lands, and none of what's happenin' here is good news on one's doorstep. This letter oughta do the trick.$B$BYe can travel back through Dun Algaz or fly from Menethil Harbor to get to Ironforge.

page.objectives_text: Use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru and bring their hearts back to Prospector Whelgar.
page.description: There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!$B$BI'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!$B$BYou'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.

page.objectives_text: Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
page.description: Whatever this is all about, $N, it's epic stuff alright.$B$BI'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.$B$BIt'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!

page.objectives_text: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.
page.description: Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.$B$BTrouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.$B$BIf you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
page.completion: Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?$B$BI got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!

page.objectives_text: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village
page.description: Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.$B$BWell, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.$B$BDo us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
page.progress: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
page.completion: Yer a real lifesaver, Leif!$B$BMy husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.

page.objectives_text: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
page.description: Blessings to you, $C. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.$B$BBefore the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.$B$BWe now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
page.completion: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.

page.objectives_text: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
page.description: These belts... look closely at the leather, $N. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?$B$BI have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.$B$BVenture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
page.progress: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
page.completion: <Arynia investigates the amulets.>$B$BDo you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.$B$BI have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.$B$BI will inform my superiors of this at once.

page.objectives_text: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
page.description: Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.$B$BHe has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.$B$BDispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
page.progress: <Tallonkai lowers his voice.>$B$BDoes Xethorr still walk freely?
page.completion: I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.$B$BI have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.$B$BNormally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we kept this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.$B$BI trust you to do the same.

page.objectives_text: Collect 5 Spiked Collars from Gnoll Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.
page.description: If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.$B$BThe beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.$B$BShould you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
page.progress: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
page.completion: Quite the armful you have.$B$BWhile this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, $N.

page.objectives_text: Kill 5 Xavian Rogues, 5 Felsworn, 5 Betrayers, and 5 Hellcallers. Return to Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song afterwards.
page.description: Kurothel mentioned sightings of what they say are wolf-men. Those of the pack now lurking in greater numbers in our forest. Last we had spoken, druids were pursuing communication with those of the beast heart who displayed measured control of their animal instincts.$B$BHis written words show a darker struggle. If there is anything we can do to help see HIM again, surely quelling the demon threat that is driving him to this burning transformation will be of aid to his anguished soul.$B$BSlay the Xavian, $N.

page.objectives_text: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
page.description: Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.$B$BPlease, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
page.completion: Ah, no wonder there is such joy running through the streams of Mulgore. You have done a great service today. The wells provide much for not only our people, but to the wildlife we depend on for food, clothing, and companionship.$B$BIt is my humble pleasure to honor Mull's request. Please, accept this token of my gratitude.

page.objectives_text: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
page.description: Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!$B$B"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!$B$BIf you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.$B$BThere's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!$B$BAnd he cheats at poker!
page.progress: Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!$B$BOh? What's that you have there, traveler?
page.completion: <Bart unwraps the gift.>$B$BWhy that no good, son of a--$B$BDid he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?!
