I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!$B$BI swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--$B$BI'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!

page.objectives_text: Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
page.description: If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!$B$BMy dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.$B$B<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>$B$BSorry, and his wife... Merrin.$B$BIt doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
page.progress: What's all this about?
page.completion: <Tarrel reads the note.>$B$BOh... oh my. Poor Hollee.$B$BShe always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!$B$BI think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!

page.objectives_text: Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.
page.description: Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.$B$BThe real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.$B$BDon't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.$B$BNixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.

page.objectives_text: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.
page.description: Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.$B$BYou are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.$B$B<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
page.progress: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
page.completion: Thanks for delivering this, pal.$B$BWait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that!$B$BFine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.

page.objectives_text: Search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road leading to the Oracle Glade.
page.description: The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.$B$BI received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.$B$BPlease head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
page.completion: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...

page.objectives_text: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolaanar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
page.description: My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...$B$BTree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...$B$B<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>$B$BI may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
page.completion: The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.$B$BWe must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.

page.objectives_text: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
page.description: A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.$B$BI doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
page.completion: Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.$B$BWhatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.

page.objectives_text: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.
page.description: I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.$B$BThankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.$B$BThe core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.$B$BIn addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
page.progress: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
page.completion: Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.$B$BNow, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.

page.objectives_text: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.
page.description: The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.$B$BI do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.$B$BIt will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
page.progress: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>
page.completion: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>

page.objectives_text: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
page.description: Make no mistake, $C--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.$B$BReports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.$B$BYou will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
page.progress: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
page.completion: I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.$B$BYou have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.

page.objectives_text: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
page.description: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.$B$BI need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.$B$BTravel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
page.progress: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
page.completion: Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.$B$BWith these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.

page.objectives_text: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
page.description: Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.$B$BSomething is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.$B$BKeep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.$B$BSee this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
page.progress: Have you dealt with our little problem?
page.completion: You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.$B$BPlease accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.

page.objectives_text: Bring the crate of candles to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge.
page.description: There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.$B$BFather Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if your going that way?
page.progress: Why did the Light guide you here today?
page.completion: Ah. Candles from Ironforge.$B$BWhile I am mostly able to live independently in my hermitage, there are a few key things that I appreciate from the city and the pious.

270038.name: Calder Gray
270038.subName: Understudy of the Royal Apothecary Society
